summary: Frontend-only functional test after inline <script>/<style> extraction to external files under /public/assets. All 9 test scenarios from the review request pass. All new external JS/CSS files load, all expected globals/DOM roots exist, image fallback works, form interactions (username sanitize, payment method toggle, profile edit drawer) behave correctly. No JS ReferenceErrors, no pageerrors, no 500s. Only console noise = 403s on legacy seed images which are auto-substituted with /assets/media/placeholder.svg by the new image-fallback.js (working as intended).

issues: Seed data references broken external image URLs (multiple 403s in console). image-fallback.js correctly replaces them with placeholder.svg, but ideally seed data should reference local demo images to eliminate console noise.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Update seed data (DB seeder) to point auction images to local demo assets or a working CDN so the 8-16 console 403 warnings per listing page disappear. Functional impact = zero (image-fallback.js already handles it).
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor scope: inline <script>/<style> extraction to /public/assets is well-executed. All migrated files load with correct data-* wiring; no ReferenceError surfaced.
Consider adding an integrity/version query string (?v=) on the new custom JS files to bust CDN cache for future edits.
Seed data should not depend on unreachable remote images; even with fallback, the 403 noise pollutes browser DevTools and hurts perceived quality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend refactor (inline JS/CSS -> external assets) is fully verified across 9 scenarios. If future changes touch /public/assets/js/custom/* or the corresponding blade views, re-run the same scenarios: home + image-fallback, /register username sanitize, /auctions/{slug} data-* globals, /buyer/balance/topup payment-method toggle, /profile toggleEdit, /admin/settings + /admin/users/{id}/edit global fn availability.
